Fig. 1: Overview of the proposed method. The proposed active learning framework integrates a vision-language model (VLM) as a weak annotator, allowing each queried instance to be annotated either with a fine-grained human label or a coarse-grained VLM-generated weak label under a fixed annotation budget. Weakly labeled samples are trained using a noise-robust loss that accounts for VLM-specific error patterns.
